en.title: Full Stack Developer
en.text: Developed and maintained production full-stack web applications across React, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, and NestJS—with strong focus on clean architecture, API design, database performance, SEO, real-time features, and Agile delivery.
list: Built scalable frontend experiences with React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Redux, and React Query—including SSR, SSG, and CSR rendering patterns.
Engineered RESTful and real-time backends with Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, and Socket.IO, integrated with MySQL, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL.
Designed data layers using Prisma, TypeORM, and Sequelize; optimized queries, indexing, and Redis caching for performance.
Implemented authentication, role-based access, and secure API workflows for production client platforms.
Shipped tested, maintainable code with Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress; deployed services on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda).
Collaborated with UI/UX, QA, and engineering teams in Agile/Scrum to deliver HR, messaging, and LMS products on schedule.
